title: Children's wrist fractures: a third set of Salter-Harris II, torus/greenstick and complete fractures
description: Wrist radiographs (frontal and lateral of one initial trauma study) of children from GRAZPEDWRI-DX, the fracture boxed on both views in annotations reviewed by pediatric radiologists. One distal radius fracture per child, typed by the dataset's AO/OTA pediatric code: Salter-Harris II (E/2), incomplete metaphyseal, torus/buckle or greenstick (M/2), and complete metaphyseal (M/3). Studies with a cast, metal, osteopenia or an uncertain diagnosis were excluded.

The fracture type in the label is read from the AO/OTA pediatric code in dataset.csv (E/2 = Salter-Harris II; M/2 = incomplete, torus/buckle or greenstick; M/3 = complete metaphyseal).
provenanceDetail.note: AO/OTA pediatric code 23r-M/3.1 (dataset.csv); age 12.1 y, M, side R.

referenceTargets.unassessedNote: Only the fracture is boxed; the ulna, carpal bones and soft tissues are not referenced.
referenceTargets.teachingNote: Complete metaphyseal fracture (AO PCCF M/3): the line crosses the whole radius, through both cortices, with the growth plate spared.
